feedback: I reviewed the candidate against the race history. It has not raced, so I state no outcome for it. The candidate is valid: all values are inside the contract ranges, and the sensor layout, base_speed 1.3, ki 0 and line_loss 'last_direction' match iteration 3, the best raced design (score 634.7). The only change is kd 0.7 to 0.8 with kp 3.8 held. Iteration 3 showed that raising kp from 3.5 to 3.8 (with kd 0.6 to 0.7) lifted the score from 556.7 to 634.7. The oval finished 19/20 (max_error 0.018) and the s-bend finished 15/20 (up from 9/20, oscillation 0.37). The slalom still ended off track in 20/20 runs, at progress 0.49, with max_error 0.063 and 1.05 line-loss events. Iteration 2 showed that cutting base_speed to 1.2 lost 113 points, so speed stays at 1.3. A small kd step is a low-risk test of damping, and the race will show whether it helps. Approve it now: the candidate is a close, well-isolated step from the best design, and the telemetry will sharpen the next critique. After the race, read per-track finish rates, steering_oscillation and the slalom max_error and line_loss_events together. If the s-bend oscillation falls and the slalom progress rises, the next step is a further small change in the same direction. If the oval starts to exit or the slalom max_error stays above 0.06, the next test is line_loss 'search_left' or 'search_right', but only if the last valid signal shows a consistent one-sided exit. Keep ki at 0.
requested_changes: After the race: if the s-bend steering_oscillation falls below 0.37 and the slalom progress rises above 0.49, keep kp 3.8 and try kd 0.9 to see whether more damping keeps helping, since kd 0.6 to 0.7 gave the best score so far.

After the race: if the oval drops to 18/20 or below, or the slalom progress does not improve over 0.49, return to kd 0.7 and change line_loss rather than gain, testing 'search_left' or 'search_right' only if the last valid signal shows a consistent one-sided exit on the slalom (iteration 3 showed max_error 0.063 and 1.05 line-loss events there).
Keep base_speed at 1.3 and ki at 0, because iteration 2 showed that base_speed 1.2 cost more on the s-bend and oval (score 521.7) than it gained on the slalom.
